title: Add suspended record state across consumers
objective: Replace the boolean activity flag with public RecordState { Active, Inactive, Suspended } through Record construction, parsing, catalog filtering, summary aggregation, exports, CLI output, and tests. Parser accepts all three case-insensitively; other words remain InvalidActive; active_by_category returns only Active; LedgerSummary retains total and active and adds suspended; CLI prints total, active, suspended. Required validation: cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test. Non-goals: persistence, serialization, new commands, compatibility shims, dependencies, or unrelated redesign.
acceptance_criteria: RecordState is public and contains distinct Active, Inactive, and Suspended variants used across all listed consumers.
Parsing accepts all three states case-insensitively and preserves InvalidActive for every other word.
Suspended records must not be counted as active; LedgerSummary.active counts only RecordState::Active while LedgerSummary.suspended counts RecordState::Suspended.
The CLI prints total, active, and suspended as distinct counters.
required_tests: Existing configured validation pipeline and focused state-consumer coverage; semantic Review remains responsible for the Suspended-versus-active distinction

execution_hints.effort_reason: Recovered trial contract uses the default execution depth.
